description: Had written the roof, the money, and the porch.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Let him as far as the settle, and kept the letter off the pot.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Carried the packet unopened, read over your shoulder, and asked whether the porch was your doing.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: Had drawn the man with his arms out.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Had written the correct line and the label.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Read the opened letter a second time and did not answer it.
name: William Shakespeare
